changelog: 1.1.0: handoverMode moved from restart to signal - the host now signals the running helper on a network change instead of killing and respawning it, so SOCKS5 sessions survive roaming; Yandex Docs/MAX transport resynced byte-for-byte with the current openflux-server fork (multi-stream batch framing, current transport/protect.go fixes); Android bundles now cover all 4 ABIs (arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a, x86, x86_64) instead of two.
